title: RBI Issues Rural Co-operative Banks Supervisory Directions, 2026 on Fair Loan Interest Practices
description: RBI issues Supervisory Directions, 2026 requiring rural co-operative banks to review loan interest, EMI and disbursal practices and address unfair charges.The post RBI Issues Rural Co-operative Banks Supervisory Directions, 2026 on Fair Loan Interest Practices appeared first on TaxGuru.
